[Act: arbitration
 Chapter: Conciliation
 Section: 66::Conciliator not bound by certain enactments.
]


The conciliator is not bound by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908) or the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 (1 of 1872).
